production.note: PROVISIONAL (database). Japanese-market calendar years. Goo-net: Spec R launched January 1999 ('発売日' January 1999); Gulliver's catalog for the same grade prints the range "平成11年1月（1999年1月）〜平成14年11月（2002年11月）" (gulliver-s15-spec-r-6mt). The S15 was not sold new in the US.

body.note: Two-door coupe ('ドア数 2枚' on gulliver-s15-spec-r-6mt). The open Silvia Varietta was sold under its own name and is not part of this record.

displacementL.note: 1,998 cc ('総排気量 1998cc'); supercars.net: '1998 cc / 121.9 in³'. Gulliver prints the rounded '排気量 2000cc' (gulliver-s15-spec-r-6mt). PROVISIONAL (database and enthusiast site).

aspiration.note: '過給機 ＩＣ付きターボ' (turbo with intercooler)

fuel.note: '無鉛プレミアムガソリン' (unleaded premium)

drivetrain.note: '駆動方式 FR' (front engine, rear-wheel drive)

transmission.note: PROVISIONAL (database). Gulliver lists the Spec R with '６速マニュアル' and a separate Spec R '４AT' grade (gulliver-s15-spec-r-4at), which was rated lower: '225ps（165kW）/6000rpm', '1270kg'.

powerHp.note: PROVISIONAL (database and enthusiast site). 250 PS (184 kW) x 0.98632 = 246.6, rounded to 247 hp; 6-speed manual. Quote (Goo-net, Spec R 6MT, January 1999): "最高出力 250ps(184kW)/6400rpm". Gulliver's catalog prints the same line, "250ps（184kW）/6400rpm" (gulliver-s15-spec-r-6mt; same catalog data, same grade ID, so not independent). supercars.net (Nick Dellis): "184.2 kw / 247 bhp @ 6400 rpm" (supercars-s15-spec-r-1999). The 4-speed automatic Spec R was rated 225 PS.

weightLb.note: PROVISIONAL (database and enthusiast site). Spec R, 6-speed manual, standard car: 1,240 kg x 2.20462 = 2,733.7, rounded to 2,734 lb. Quote (Goo-net): "車両重量 1240kg" (Japanese catalog vehicle weight, i.e. kerb weight). Gulliver prints the same 1240kg for the same grade (gulliver-s15-spec-r-6mt; same catalog data). supercars.net agrees: "curb weight | 1240 kg / 2734 lbs" (supercars-s15-spec-r-1999).

provisionalNote: Power (247 hp from 250 PS) and weight (2,734 lb from 1,240 kg) rest on the Goo-net catalog (a database; Gulliver's catalog carries the same data) and supercars.net (enthusiast site, Nick Dellis), agreeing exactly; supercars.net may simply restate the same Japanese catalog data, so the two may not be independent. Production years, displacement and transmissions also rest on those catalogs. A Nissan source (Nissan Heritage Collection page, 1999 press release or catalogue) or an Evo/Autocar specification panel for the S15 Spec-R would replace them.
